title: web paged result record (v1)
description: One logical web result of a multi-request pagination run as one JSONL result record: the original zero-based position in its own page's upstream web.results array, the user-facing page it came from, and the usable textual members. Records are emitted in deduplicated first-seen order as their pages complete; the exact API-provided URL string is the deduplication identity. Absent members are omitted, never emitted as null.

page.$comment: The user-facing page number whose upstream response first carried this result.
